# How long until buying beats renting, and what rent makes them equal?

> Free rent vs buy calculator: month-by-month comparison with the down payment invested, closing and selling costs, PMI and the itemized-deduction test. Shows the break-even year and the rent that makes them equal. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/rent-vs-buy-breakeven-calculator/)
